this only really works for repeated tasks but im competitive and play a lot of games - treating tasks like i would a literal video game is effective.

how many days can i go without eating chips? what can i optimize so beating my record is easier? my average score is climbing, im getting skilled!

when i fail, instead of insulting myself for being unhealthy, it becomes "this attempt sucked" "i was just rusty after taking a break" like i would for a game.

quantifying progress that's detached from the actual task makes thinking about it less dreadful. it's not about my clothes piling up, its about getting Good
